description: This charming single-family residence in Riverside offers the perfect blend of comfort and functionality. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 well-appointed bathrooms, the home is thoughtfully designed to accommodate both everyday living and entertaining.The interior boasts a bright and open layout, with abundant natural light flowing through the living areas, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen provides ample space for cooking and gathering, seamlessly connecting to the dining and living areas. Each bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, while the primary suite includes its own private bathroom for added convenience.Outside, the property provides a private yard with plenty of potential for outdoor enjoyment, whether it’s relaxing, gardening, or hosting gatherings. Conveniently located near local amenities, schools, and parks, this home is an excellent opportunity for comfortable living in a desirable Riverside neighborhood.
